_doc: Each brief runs through /find-font. Every answer is also checked for: valid ids, the role in each font's use tags, body/ui weight and italics rules, and 3 ids per role (or every candidate if fewer). Optional fields add checks: roles (each inner list = acceptable names for one required role; any other role fails as extra), scripts (every pick covers them), pair (the pairing rules apply to the top picks), replaces (top pick of the first role is in that avoid entry's instead list), public_repo (top picks are OFL or the answer warns about Fontshare and public repos), category (every pick is in it), top_use (some role's top pick has this use tag), top_feel_any (some top pick has one of these feel tags).
